post.description:
Creates a new webhook subscription for entity events.
            
⚠️ IMPORTANT: The response includes a secret that will be used to sign webhook payloads. Store this secret securely as it cannot be retrieved later.
            
Sample request:
            
    POST /api/v3/webhooks
    {
       "url": "https://example.com/webhook",
       "events": ["ProjectAdded", "ProjectStatusChanged", "ProjectDeleted"],
       "headers": {
          "X-Custom-Header": "custom-value"
       }
    }
            
Scope: the optional "scope" field controls delivery. When omitted, the webhook is created as
"Account" (account-wide delivery), which requires the "Manage system settings" permission. Pass
"User" to receive only events the creator is allowed to see; that can be created by any non-guest user.
            
Available Event Types:
            
Project Events:
- "ProjectAdded"
- "ProjectDeleted"
- "ProjectNameChanged"
- "ProjectDescriptionChanged"
- "ProjectPriorityChanged"
- "ProjectStatusChanged"
- "ProjectCustomerChanged"
- "ProjectPortfolioChanged"
- "ProjectDatesChanged"
- "ProjectEstimatedHoursChanged"
- "ProjectBudgetChanged"
- "ProjectBillingTypeChanged"
- "ProjectCustomFieldChanged"
- "ProjectMemberAdded"
- "ProjectMemberRemoved"
- "ProjectMemberJobRoleChanged"
            
Task Events:
- "TaskAdded"
- "TaskNameChanged"
- "TaskDescriptionChanged"
- "TaskPriorityChanged"
- "TaskStatusChanged"
- "TaskCategoryChanged"
- "TaskProjectChanged"
- "TaskDatesChanged"
- "TaskEstimatedHoursChanged"
- "TaskBudgetChanged"
- "TaskBillingTypeChanged"
- "TaskCustomFieldChanged"
- "TaskAssigneeAdded"
- "TaskAssigneeRemoved"
            
Message Events:
- "MessageAdded"
- "MessageApproved"
- "MessageRejected"
            
Expense Events:
- "ExpenseAdded"
            
Time Entry Events:
- "TimeEntryAdded"
            
Note: The authoritative list of allowed values is the `events` schema in this operation (enum `WebhookEventType`).

requestBody.description: The webhook configuration including URL, entity type, and event types to subscribe to

201.description: Returns the newly created webhook with secret

400.description: If the request is invalid (e.g., missing URL or event types)

403.description: If the user does not have permission to create webhooks

get.description:
Retrieves all webhook subscriptions for the current account.
            
Sample requests:
            
    GET /api/v3/webhooks
    GET /api/v3/webhooks?publicIds=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&publicIds=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002

parameters.name: PublicIds
parameters.description: Array of public IDs to filter the webhooks.

403.description: If the user does not have permission to view webhooks

delete.description:
Deletes an existing webhook subscription. Once deleted, the webhook will no longer receive event notifications.
            
Sample request:
            
    DELETE /api/v3/webhooks/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001

parameters.name: publicId
parameters.description: The unique public identifier (GUID) of the webhook to delete

400.description: If the webhook ID is invalid (empty GUID)

403.description: If the user does not have permission to delete the webhook

404.description: If the webhook does not exist (or is not visible to the caller)
